pattern.title: Observed execution-cost pattern
pattern.question: Identify the dominant pattern explicitly shown by this observation or small code excerpt. Do not infer runtime magnitude, complexity, or a performance improvement. Multiple equally dominant patterns mean unsure.

criteria.repeated_work: Shows repeated computation, queries, or transformations on equivalent input.
criteria.copying: Shows data allocation, copying, materialization, or movement.
criteria.boundary: Shows repeated I/O, process, network, FFI, or synchronization boundaries.
criteria.waiting: Shows observed lock contention or waiting.
criteria.unsure: The evidence is ambiguous, mixed, or does not support a reliable choice.
